notes: Wood is a new raw resource with two acquisition paths: harvested from forested planetary biomes (early game, non-renewable at the deposit level), or produced renewably by the Arboretum 5 m (mid/late game, alongside fruits and resin byproducts). No asteroids — biogenic. Can be burned directly in Coal Power's Combustion Generator 2.5 m at ~15% efficiency, or refined into charcoal via the Smelter 2.5 m (pyrolysis) for ~40% efficiency.

resources.description: Cellulose-rich plant material. In the wild, mature trees on forested biomes drop wood when felled — v0.1 accepts vanilla drilling as a temporary harvesting mechanic; a dedicated forestry tool (chainsaw / logging harvester) is deferred to a future mod. Alternatively produced renewably by the Arboretum 5 m. Burns directly in Coal Power's Combustion Generator at ~15% efficiency; refines into charcoal via pyrolysis (2 wood → 1 charcoal via Smelter 2.5 m) for a much higher combustion efficiency.
